what: The validator's naming-convention rule reports whitespace in any name attribute as an error. On CADAssembly, CADPart and CADFace the X3D 4.0 object model types name as a plain SFString label, and the X3D 4.0 schema accepts the file.
object_model: x3d_mcp fa4a8e3, src/validation/schemas/X3dUnifiedObjectModel-4.0.xml: CADAssembly, CADPart, CADFace, CADLayer name = SFString, no simpleType; HAnimJoint name = SFString with baseType xs:NMTOKEN
what_we_did: Before the fix the shipped scenes were given names without spaces (BC1_body, CourtCanopyTruss) and the spaced original was kept in controls/. After the fix the spaced original has 0 errors as well. The shipped scenes keep the unspaced names, which pass on both validator commits.
grade: Confirmed on both commits. That the rule was the side to change rests on the X3D 4.0 and 4.1 object models typing these ten names as plain SFString (Likely as a reading of intent).

measured_after_the_fix.validator: x3d_mcp 4519043 (the name rule reads the field's type from the object model)
